title: Pokemon Card Keldeo Silver Tempest Reverse Holo Rare 046/195 Near Mint
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This rare Pokémon card features the character Keldeo from the Tempest set of the Pokémon Trading Card Game. The card is a Reverse Holo type with a card number of 046/195, and it has a silver finish. The card's name is Reversal and it is a Pokémon type card. 

This collectible card is perfect for any fan of the Pokémon TCG and would make a great addition to any collection. Its rarity and unique features make it a valuable card to own. Don't miss out on the opportunity to add this rare Pokémon card to your collection!
